features: 【Dual Band AC WIRELESS ROUTER】Dual band network with wireless speed 400Mbps (2.4G) + 867Mbps (5G), Tethering compatible. A very stable and powerful IPQ4018 @717MHz processor. PACKAGING CONTENTS: GL-A1300 (Slate Plus) Router with one year limited warranty, AC adapter (UK and EU plug), Ethernet cable and user manual.

【Open Source & Programmable】 Slate Plus runs on the latest OpenWrt 21.02 operating system and significantly reduces signal interference. You can customize the router and install applications according to your preferences.
【VPN CLIENT & SERVER】 OpenVPN and WireGuard pre-installed, compatible with over 30 VPN service providers. Max. VPN speed of 28 Mbps (OpenVPN); 190 Mbit/s (WireGuard)

【NETWORK STORAGE】Our network storage function supports SAMBA and WebDap protocols. By connecting an external USB hard drive to the router, you can create a private network storage to store and share your documents.

【CAN BE WIDELY USED】 No matter you are in hotel, cafe, airport, restaurant, camper or other places, you can connect the router to the public Wi-Fi hotspot and secure your connected devices. It is small and lightweight, 118 x 84 x 33 mm (L x W x H) / 429 g, which is very convenient to carry during work or travel.

【INTERNET KILL SWITCH VPN】 This is a countermeasure concept of enabling a single stop mechanism for all Internet traffic. If this feature is enabled, the router must run a VPN client (OpenVPN or WireGuard) all the time, if one of the VPN clients is not running, the devices connected to the router are not allowed to access the Internet.
【VPN POLICY】You can set VPN routing policies, it is possible to use VPN for a specific website/IP while maintaining normal internet traffic without VPN for others.

【Activate VPN or AdGuard Home easily】Immediately turn on/off the selected feature (AdGuard Home or OpenVPN client or WireGuard client) via the physical toggle switch. ***The default setting of the button is NO function, you must set it in the admin panel before using this function. ***
description: Slate Plus (GL-A1300) is a pocket-sized Wi-Fi 5 travel router with a powerful processor optimized for network stability and efficient VPN encryption processing. It includes our latest security features and runs on the latest OpenWright operating system. It is designed for frequent travelers who have a high demand for the use of VPN networks.
